stem: Based on these excerpts, which statement describes the ideas of Presidents Davis and Lincoln?

options.label: A
options.text: Both Davis and Lincoln believed that it was unlawful for a state to break from the union.

options.label: B
options.text: Both Davis and Lincoln believed that states had the authority to wage war against the union.

options.label: C
options.text: Davis believed that the federal government made secession necessary, while Lincoln believed the union must be preserved.

options.label: D
options.text: Lincoln believed that a state must prove the right to secede, while Davis believed that any state could secede at any time.

visual_elements: Two excerpts from presidential inaugural addresses by Jefferson Davis and Abraham Lincoln
